note: The contrast to naming-scb-variant-without-a-variant-entry-withholds-the-register (step 1), whose unnamed variant withholds its whole register. Here both delivered variants have a `[[variant]]` entry, but variant 20's Registervariantnamn cell is blank, so the source establishes no name for it (unknown_parent_name, catalog_resolution.py) and it resolves to nothing. That withholds neither the register nor the variable: value keeps its supported people state, and only the state its others row would form is withheld (withheld_variant_dependency). The replaced test cleared the second record's variant name fact; a blank cell is how a delivery states that. Its withheld_output == ("state",) needs the `issues.withheld_output` runner field that #1316 adds and is not asserted; the outcome it names (only the state is withheld, the variable and its sibling state stay) is. The runner's default Unika summary row for that column copies the blank Registervariantnamn, and a support row with a blank join coordinate has no key (`support_join_key`, source_support.py), so the build also reports unknown_support_key: a fixture artifact the replaced test (support bypassed) never saw, which the scoped `issues` projection leaves unasserted.
fails_if: `form_native_variable` (source_formation.py) withholds the whole variable, or every state of it, when one of its variants is unresolved, so value loses its people state; or source-scope resolution treats a named variant without a source name like an unnamed one and withholds the register (withheld_register_dependency, no people state); or formation skips the unresolved variant's row silently instead of reporting withheld_variant_dependency on it

sources.description: Register 1 (TESTREG) delivers VALUE (variable 101) in its 2020 edition in variant 10 (CVID 1001) and in variant 20 (CVID 1002), whose Registervariantnamn cell is blank.
